;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**Fighting breaks out between [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants and [[Afghan National Police|Afghan police]] in the [[Haska Mina District]], [[Nangarhar Province]], leaving six police officers and 15 militants dead, according to officials. [http://www.rferl.org/content/afghanistan-islamic-state-attack-police-killed/27792176.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**[[Libya]]n forces claim to have captured the port in the city of [[Sirte]] after heavy fighting with [[Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-36505935 (BBC)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**According to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]], two suicide bombings occur near the [[Sayyidah Zaynab]] shrine in a [[Damascus]] suburb, killing at least 20 people. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-blast-idUSKCN0YX05Y (Reuters)]
